The '''Kibilini sector''' was located within the regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[planet]] [[Adelphi]] was located in the [[sector]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[229 BBY]]<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'' take place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]], which ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[230 BBY]].</ref>, at least part of the sector was located within the [[Occlusion Zone]]. The [[Jedi Master]]s [[Avar Kriss]] and [[Porter Engle]], along with the [[Ugnaught]] [[pilot]] [[Belin]] and the [[Journalist|reporter]] [[Rhil Dairo]], took refuge in an [[Kibilini sector asteroid field|asteroid field]] located within the sector after leaving [[Hetzal Prime|Hetzal]].<ref name="Eye of Darkness" />
